open_points.subject: record_flow_output
open_points.text: InputSource discriminated union on field 'source_kind' (exact variants, no others exist): RecordedSource (source_kind='recorded'), ListElementSource (source_kind='list_element'), MappedListSource (source_kind='mapped_list'); a value of InputSource is an instance of one of these variants, never of another model, and InputSource itself is not constructed
open_points.other_text: A RecordedSource MUST answer a StoredValuesRef with its ref's value_id and port the source's port, the flow output port's name; a MappedListSource MUST publish its list's StoredValue with put_value_bytes and write it in one RecordDeliveryValuesChange through record_change under the given actor before answering its ref; it checks nothing, since a flow output holds the value its edge delivered and is of value carriage (A05 rule 7).
open_points.question: Must record_flow_output's source type exclude ListElementSource, or must its required behavior specify how ListElementSource is recorded?

set_aside.subject: assemble_mapped_lists
set_aside.text: a value list is one StoredValue whose bytes are canonical_bytes of the JSON array text made of the elements' stored bytes — each read with read_value_bytes — in element order, separated by commas, between [ and ], whose value_schema is the canonical array schema with the port's stored schema (M21: its value_schema, or for a many port the canonical array schema with it as items) as items, of the class highest_disclosure_class gives for the elements' StoredValues — read through read_records with one RecordsById naming their value_ids —, its value_digest content_identity of a BytesContent holding the bytes and value_id content_identity of the StoredValueContent; a file list is one SpooledFilesRef listing every element's files in element order, whose disclosure_class is the highest class among the elements' SpooledFilesRefs.
set_aside.other_text: PortRef discriminated union on field 'ref_kind' (exact variants, no others exist): StoredValuesRef (ref_kind='stored_values'), SpooledFilesRef (ref_kind='spooled_files'), FileFactsRef (ref_kind='file_facts'); a value of PortRef is an instance of one of these variants, never of another model, and PortRef itself is not constructed
set_aside.question: Must FileFactsRef be removed from the PortRefs permitted as MappedList elements, or must assemble_mapped_lists define how FileFactsRef elements are assembled?
set_aside.set_aside_because: an unchanged passage of a unit reviewed for its change
